column1: # The kind table of `places_pack poi-link`: how the base map's chip kinds line up with the places pack's records.
# It is data between two schemas, not language rules.
#   tile_kind  Protomaps v4 `pois.kind` (the value in the tiles; the kinds of app/lib/maps/poi_chips.dart)
#   class      the chip's icon (poi_chips.dart `PoiIcon.id`): two records of the SAME class and name close together are one place
#              mapped twice and are merged; records of different classes ("Stinker" the fuel station and "Stinker" the convenience
#   osm_tags   the places pack's `places.kind` for a record from OpenStreetMap (`key=value`, as the pack writes it), comma-joined:
#              a chip links only to a record whose kind is listed for its tile kind. A record of another kind never answers the chip.
